# Northwind Studio brand guidelines

## Logo
Keep clear space equal to the height of the N.

## Typography
Headings use a geometric sans; body text uses a humanist sans.

## Voice
Warm, precise, never shouty.

# Brand Assets

Approved logos, palettes and guidelines. Ask Maya before adding files.

# Campaigns 2026

One subfolder per campaign. Launch plans live in each campaign folder.
